subject: Biology
chapter: Chapter 19: Excretory Products and Their Elimination
central_question: How do human kidneys form concentrated urine, regulate body-fluid composition and eliminate metabolic wastes?
in_scope_units: Human excretory system and nephron organisation.
banned_topics: Absorption of nutrients in intestinal villi
Detailed circulation beyond renal blood supply

known_pitfalls.correction: ADH increases water reabsorption and reduces diuresis.

known_pitfalls.claim: Both limbs of Henle loop have the same permeability.
known_pitfalls.correction: The descending limb is water permeable; the ascending limb is water impermeable and transports salts.
Nearly 99 percent of about 180 litres per day is reabsorbed, leaving about 1-1.5 litres of urine.
